Plan Information

Japan

Explore Japan with confidence, knowing reliable connectivity is always in your pocket. From the electric streets of Tokyo and the powder slopes of Hokkaido to the sacred trails of Mount Fuji, FlexiRoam keeps you connected wherever your Japanese adventure takes you.

More on your FlexiRoam eSIM:
✔ Activate your plan within 3 months of purchase to keep it valid.
✔ Auto-connects to the strongest available network in Japan. Prefer a specific carrier? Switch manually anytime.
✔ Unlimited plans are subject to a speed cap after the 3GB daily fair usage limit. Learn More.

Important Note: Flexi Share is not available on Unlimited Data Plans.
